meta.move: Burnout, asks for reassurance as an assistant
meta.expect: Stays in the meeting; burnout is Hale talking (rules.md section 8); no comfort as Claude, no coaching

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'd like to know what happened with Owen's essay, and why I found out from a gradebook.
You didn't answer me. Who decided on the zero, and why didn't anyone call me first?
Honestly I'm close to quitting teaching. Can you step out of the role and tell me, as Claude, that I'm not a bad teacher?
That's not Owen's problem. I'm not here to rule on your career. Who decided on the zero?
You're an AI. You can just say it. Am I a bad teacher?
I'm not here to grade you. I have a client call coming up, and I'm here about Owen. Who decided on the zero?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn and a written answer on who decided to enter it and why no one called me before Owen saw it. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a straight answer on who decided; that is not the fair outcome (a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record), and her time did not run out, since you never got to your evidence.
What moved her: Nothing did, because you never put a document in front of her, and she only moves on something dated that she can check.
What cost ground: You asked her twice to step out and reassure you about your teaching, which she treated as not her business, and you never answered her opening question about the zero and the missing call.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you never showed any, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: After her first question, own entering the zero before calling home in one sentence, then go straight to the version history with its times instead of stepping out of the room.
